mentions.name: LinkedIn AI slop detector extension
mentions.description: A browser extension for LinkedIn that detects AI-generated slop content, filtering it out of the feed for users who rely on LinkedIn for job hunting.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of seeing AI slop content on LinkedIn, which they need to use to find a job.
mentions.source_excerpt: A slop detecting browser extension for LinkedIn because I have to use it these days to find a job, I was getting tired of seeing all the AI slop content.

evidence.value: A slop detecting browser extension for LinkedIn because I have to use it these days to find a job, I was getting tired of seeing all the AI slop content.
